reviewNote: Our current take for agentic coding across the major labs. S splits into Frontier, the most capable models for hard work, and Chores, the best value for routine work. Same-tier order is editorial, not a measured gap. Models reviewed but not shown are listed in notShown with the reason.

models.name: Opus 5.5

points.text: Best on FrontierCode, a test of merge-ready code: 52.2%.
Over 10× GPT-6.1 Sol’s cost per FrontierCode task.

models.rationale: S Frontier and the leader: first in Agent Arena (+20.9% against +14.7% for the next model), AA’s FrontierCode 1.1 (52.2%) and Theo’s blind architecture audit (8.40). It also leads AA’s Coding Agent Index v2.0 (61.7, ahead of Sonnet 5.5’s 59.3 and Muse Wonder Full’s 58.9). It is not first everywhere: AA puts GPT-6.1 Sol within three points on FrontierCode at under a tenth of the cost per task. Kirill’s view that it leads almost every metric holds against this evidence.

leadCheck.note: Still on top after Muse Wonder Full, Gemini 4 Argon.
leadCheck.reason: Muse Wonder Full scores 68 on AA’s Coding Agent Index, above Opus 5.5’s 66, but trails it in Agent Arena (+11.3% vs +20.9%), Code Arena WebDev (1726 vs 1806) and Theo’s audit (7.04 vs 8.40). Google’s Gemini 4 Argon launch chart leads Opus 5.5 on DeepSWE (77.9 vs 74.2), but Argon trails in Agent Arena (+12.0%), Epoch’s ECI (165 vs 167) and Theo’s audit (3.95). Neither challenge converges, so the leader holds. On Oct 23 AA’s Coding Agent Index v2.0 reversed Muse’s one lead: Opus 5.5 61.7, Muse Wonder Full 58.9.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol

points.text: FrontierCode coding test: 49.1%, at under a tenth of Opus 5.5’s cost.
Intelligence Index: 1 point below GPT-6 Astra.
Coding-agent index: 54, to Opus 5.5’s 62.

models.rationale: S Chores, the clearest value pick: 49.1% on AA’s FrontierCode at $0.81 a task (level with Fable 5.1 at under a tenth of the cost), a point below GPT-6 Astra on AA’s Intelligence Index at $0.72 a task against $3.26, #4 in Agent Arena at +13.5% (Max), and 54.1 on AA’s Coding Agent Index v2.0 at $1.50 a task, on its cost frontier between DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GPT-6 Astra ($7.04 for 54.7). Chosen over Sonnet 5.5, which is not cheap per task, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, which AA finds less capable than GPT-6.1 Sol at medium effort for a higher cost per task. Not Frontier: Opus 5.5 leads it in the same tests. On Oct 22 Arena’s Oct 20 board replaced Arena’s cost-frontier post (x.com/arena/status/2112600237491810662), so every card’s headline comes from the same board; the cost case rests on FrontierCode and AA. On Oct 23 Rails was dropped from the page; AA’s GPT-6.1 Sol launch post replaced it. On Oct 23 AA’s Coding Agent Index v2.0 replaced v1.5 on the card and the wall.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra

points.text: At xhigh, ties Opus 5.5 at 59.6% on the Terminal-Bench shell test.
FrontierCode coding test: 47.0%, behind GPT-6.1 Sol’s 49.1%.
Theo: does incredible things, and some of the stupidest.

models.rationale: A, first: #2 in Agent Arena, but behind Opus 5.5 in every reviewed head-to-head, behind GPT-6.1 Sol on FrontierCode (47.0% vs 49.1%), and about 4.5 times its AA cost per task ($3.26 vs $0.72). Moved from S when S was limited to the clear best in each lane. It takes the one slot left after each major lab’s best, edging Fable 5.1 in Agent Arena (+14.7% vs +14.2%), Code Arena WebDev and AA’s cost per task. FrontierCode replaced the Rails post on Oct 23, when Rails was dropped from the page. Theo’s reliability warning still applies.

models.name: Muse Wonder Full

points.text: Coding-agent index: 59, to Opus 5.5’s 62 and GPT-6 Astra’s 55.
#6 in Code Arena WebDev, users’ votes on AI-built web apps.
Only in Meta’s Muse Code app; no public API.

models.rationale: A: converging independent results from AA (Coding Agent Index v2.0 58.9 in Muse Code, third behind Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5; Intelligence Index 56), Agent Arena (#7, +11.3%), Code Arena WebDev (#6, 1726) and Theo’s audit (7.04, level with GPT-6 Astra). Behind Opus 5.5 in every reviewed head-to-head since v2.0 of AA’s coding index; ahead of GPT-6 Astra there (58.9 vs 54.7), which leads it in Agent Arena. Usable only through Muse Code, with no per-token price yet.

models.name: Gemini 4 Argon

points.text: Hallucination rate: 15%, lowest of top models; GPT-6 Astra’s is 51%.
Intelligence Index: 53, level with GPT-6 Astra.
Theo’s blind code audit: 47 of its 92 claims were false.

models.rationale: A, last: Agent Arena (#6, +12.0%) puts it with the tier, and AA scores it level with GPT-6 Astra. Held at the bottom of A by Theo’s blind audit (3.95, with half its checked claims false), #10 in Code Arena WebDev and Epoch’s 6th place on software engineering. Its cost per task doubles when the launch discount ends on Nov 30.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017

points.text: Best open-weights model in Agent Arena, rated on real users’ sessions.
Intelligence Index: 45, equal #2 open-weights model.
Same index: GPT-6.1 Sol at medium effort scores 48 for $0.21 a task.

models.rationale: B: the strongest open-weights model in both Arena boards (Agent Arena #11 at +5.1% for $0.20 a task at its debut, #12 at +4.7% on Oct 20) and 45 on AA’s Intelligence Index for $0.26 a task. Not S Chores: AA finds GPT-6.1 Sol at medium effort more capable for less ($0.21, 48), and Arena puts it at about 37% of Sol’s improvement for 27% of the cost. DeepSeek’s own DeepSWE chart is provider-run. FrontierCode and Rails tested the earlier V4.1 Flash, not this build.

models.name: Grok 4.7

points.text: Coding-agent index: 47, to GPT-6.1 Sol’s 54.
FrontierCode coding test: 33.8%, to GPT-6.1 Sol’s 49.1%.
Theo: unacceptably bad frontend; it gets stuck in loops.

models.rationale: F: shown because it is xAI’s latest model, but cheaper shown models beat it on converging independent evidence. GPT-6.1 Sol leads it in Agent Arena (+13.5% vs +3.2%) and FrontierCode (49.1% vs 33.8%), and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 leads it in Agent Arena (+4.7%) at a fraction of the cost. AA’s matched-effort gains over Grok 4.6 are real but do not close that gap. FrontierCode replaces xAI’s launch chart, which compared mismatched efforts.

notShown.name: Fable 5.1

notShown.note: Rechecked Oct 21 and kept over GPT-5.6 Luna. Cheapest useful OpenAI model (Agent Arena’s frontier below $0.10 a task), but far behind GPT-6.1 Sol: Agent Arena +3.0% vs +13.5%, Rails 43.5% vs 60.8%, FrontierCode 41.9% vs 49.1%.

notShown.note: 41.8% on FrontierCode and 43 on AA’s Intelligence Index; GPT-6.1 Sol at medium effort scores higher on AA for $0.21 a task. Not a Chores pick.

notShown.note: Meta’s API model. Behind Muse Wonder Full in Agent Arena (+3.7% vs +11.3%), Code Arena WebDev (1651 vs 1726) and AA’s Coding Agent Index v2.0 (52 vs 58.9).

notShown.note: Over the seven-model limit. Agent Arena +1.8% (#25), Code Arena WebDev 1655, FrontierCode 43.6%, AA 44: behind DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 at a higher cost.
